spec.title: 020: The Harness Tool Bridge, Seat Profiles & the Tool Inventory

summary.text: A subscription CLI (`specs/009` §7) runs its own loop, so a harness span for a role without a worktree used to be **text-only**: the Delphi chat's orchestrator, served by `claude` on a subscription, could not set a timer, dispatch an agent or read a scoped file, and its harness note said so. That is the normal setup for an operator with no API access, including an organization that signs in to Claude Enterprise through SSO (Okta): an SSO seat is a `claude.ai` login, which is the harness path and nothing else.
